purpose: Let one exact product source declare the Tencent pre-debit IAM deployment attestation it accepts, so an installer resolves the attestation contract from the Candidate source it is about to install instead of a hand-maintained per-candidate registry.
machineBoundary: The attestation schema version, proof mode, release binding, required actions and required policies that services/fabric/cmd/opl-tencent-provisioner enforces on OPL_TENCENT_PREDEBIT_IAM_ATTESTATION. The contract name is the installation-side vocabulary for that same shape; the attestation content itself stays with the installer that produces it.

lifecycle.removalCondition: Replace only with a newer attestation shape the same provisioner accepts.
